dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Severe nonketotic hyperglycemia–induced generalized chorea/ballismus (diabetic striatopathy), due to previously unrecognized or uncontrolled diabetes mellitus

ALTERNATIVE 1: Functional neurological movement disorder with functional seizures

ALTERNATIVE 2: Focal or generalized epileptic seizures without an ictal EEG correlate

ALTERNATIVE 3: Hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state–associated encephalopathy with abnormal movements
